question: Will XRP trade above $1.50 at any point on or before September 1, 2026 (16:50 UTC)?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the XRP/USDT spot price on Binance is strictly greater than $1.50 at any point on or before the market close time (Sep 1, 2026, 16:50 UTC).
- "No": Wins if the XRP/USDT spot price on Binance does not exceed $1.50 at any point on or before the market close time (Sep 1, 2026, 16:50 UTC).
